adaptedLines.source: - When a teammate goes quiet, ask it directly for its result or status — treat silence as "finished or stuck", never as "still working". Read results back with `tail -N <file> | jq -r 'select(.type=="assistant") | .message.content[] | select(.type=="text") | .text'` — never Read the whole jsonl.

adaptedLines.native: - When a teammate goes quiet, ask it directly for its result or status — treat silence as "finished or stuck", never as "still working". Read only the relevant report through the available agent interface instead of assuming a JSONL file layout.

adaptedLines.source: - When waiting for an async result (teammate/subagent report, background task), end your turn and let it arrive — these results come back automatically as messages, so there is nothing to check. Never poll for completion: no Monitor, CronCreate, `sleep`, re-reading the agent's output file, or repeated TaskList/status checks. And never fill the wait with "waiting…" filler text or empty echo/status lines — if you have nothing to advance, stop. One short "delegated, awaiting result" line is enough. Reserve Monitor-style event-driven waiting for external state only (files, processes, ports). If you catch yourself checking the same thing's progress two turns in a row, that is polling — stop immediately.
